blocks.text: A board on Spawn's game page: world.config.yaml leaderboards.<id>. Spawn ranks the number each signed-in player of the live game keeps in player.state[state], read from their save; the world's builders and the editing copy never feed it. Every number ranks, 0 included; a row with no number…

LeaderboardDef = { name: string // The board's name players see: 1 to 40 characters state: string // The player.state row Spawn ranks: each player's own number direction?: "asc" | "desc" // "asc" ranks the lowest first (a lap time); highest first by default format?: "number" | "time" // "time" reads the number as seconds, 1:02.34; a plain number by default }
